messages:
Owen Garcia: hi team, first week here. I updated my MBP to Sonoma this morning and after restart Kandji shows "profile checksum mismatch" and the device is flagged as "requires re-enrollment". macOS says "MDM profile cannot be verified" in Settings. wifi is working. anyone seen this after OS updates?
Sophie Alvarez: welcome @Owen! yep, sometimes the post-update flow changes the stored profile signature. Did you complete the Setup Assistant network steps when the update finished? if you deferred, the MDM check-in can fail.
Owen Garcia: i clicked through quickly and hit "set up later" on a couple prompts. how do i re-enroll without wiping?
IT Helpdesk Bot: Auto-scan: serial C02SONOMA123 enrolled but profile_status=checksum_mismatch. Suggested actions: try remote profile push or run local enrollment renew. Open ticket #ONB-9662.
Sophie Alvarez: easiest first step: try forcing an enrollment refresh from the Mac. Open Terminal and run: 

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```

Then check System Settings > Profiles and the Kandji web UI. If that doesn't work, we can push a remote profile reinstall from Kandji.
Owen Garcia: ran the renew command. it returned: "No enrollment found". Kandji UI still says requires re-enrollment.
Sophie Alvarez: ok, that usually means the local record got orphaned. i'll trigger a remote reinstall of the MDM profile and, if needed, a Kandji agent reinstall. can you stay on a trusted network for ~5 mins?
IT Helpdesk Bot: Remote job queued: "install-mdm-profile" for C02SONOMA123 by Sophie Alvarez. Estimated 60s.
Kandji Admin: remote job completed: MDM profile installed and agent re-registered. Kandji: device status -> online. Please log out and back in to complete profile activation.
Owen Garcia: logged out and back in, Settings now shows the MDM profile and Okta device trust passed. thanks! quick note: the update flow hid the "Install Profile" prompt behind the updater, so i didn't notice it.
Sophie Alvarez: great. can you add a 1-liner to the onboarding checklist to keep network connected and avoid deferring setup after OS updates? i'll fold it into the infra runbook.
Owen Garcia: added the note in #docs-onboarding. appreciate the fast help. :sparkles:
